i would NEVER watch something like drama  on my own initiative. But right now as I was searching for something else, I found Squid Games Season 3 review by Rei  -  and she described Season 1 of this drama so amazingly that I am interested in watching it.So I am going to post a link to her review bc nobody else analyzed it so deeply. Ppl tend to see it as a thriller and "fun" but in fact it is very deep.This is the jist of what she said about Season 1:  "Once upon a red light, green light, Squid Game burst onto the global stage like a Molotov cocktail tossed into the living room of late-stage capitalism. It was brutal, brilliant, and blisteringly clear: the system isn’t broken—it’s functioning exactly as intended, and it grinds the desperate beneath its boot. Season 1 wasn't just a show; it was a cultural autopsy. Equal parts thriller and thinkpiece, it painted desperation in high-contrast red and green and let us watch as humanity's worst systems played out as children's games with blood-slicked stakes."Here is the link to the reviews, her comment is like 4th from the top, titled: Squid Game 3 – Capitalism’s Knife is Now a Plastic Spoon:https://mydramalist.com/771707-squid-game-season-3/reviewsThere is no direct link bc she is not a user here but went to her own blog byrei

Finally got around to watching this.I don't think it's possible to express how underwhelmed I am, particularly given the multi-year hype and smash ratings.Some great actors in service to an abundantly lame story.Or maybe it's the execution that sucks. I am not familiar with the source material, so can't say.The metaphors/allegory are so on the nose as to be painful.I made it through all of episode 1, then started skipping ahead depending on what it looked like might be going on, then ditched the remaining episodes completely.Pretty bad.3/10

I'd argue it's the execution that sucks. I'd give s1 of squid game a 6/10 personally. I think the premise was there and it was interesting but the first couple episodes drag on far too much before it gets to the main games and even then it feels way too long for such a short drama. Seeing as you gave it a 3/10 for s1 I can guarantee you that the next 2 seasons would be a 1/10 or even lower if it was possible to rate in negative numbers.
